title: Circuit Breakers Don't Fix
subtitle: A breaker limits the blast radius of a failing dependency; it does not repair it

panels.heading: Dependency Degrades
panels.caption: The upstream slows down; callers wait on long timeouts and threads pile up
panels.note: Slow calls still count as successes unless they exceed a deadline

panels.heading: Breaker Opens
panels.caption: Failures cross the threshold; calls are short-circuited and fail fast
panels.note: Your capacity is protected: threads, queues and tail latency recover

panels.heading: Dependency Still Broken
panels.caption: Half-open probes fail; nothing upstream has been repaired
panels.note: Open breakers can mask degradation and synchronized probes can stampede recovery

strip_caption: Use the breaker inside a larger pattern, then remediate the dependency itself

steps.label: Circuit Breaker
steps.detail: Fail fast on a known-bad path
